recorded_before: Any completed official Cosmos Policy task episode or counterfactual ranking result in this project
purpose: Native task and counterfactual decision evidence, not universal Goal-invariance
runtime_scope: Audited torch backend adapter; complete upstream Transformer Engine numerical parity is not established

clean_health.requirement: A completed environment-successful N2 episode before decision-harm expansion; a successful N1 episode alone does not validate the forecast/value planner

native_best_of_N.selection: Maximum native value; first candidate wins an exact tie

development_counterfactual.source: First completed successful official N2 health episode; do not replace prefixes after inspecting rankings
development_counterfactual.skip_rule: Record an unavailable or already-successful prefix as ineligible; do not silently replace it
development_counterfactual.committed_controls: Generate exactly two continuous 16x7 candidates once under original Goal; reuse identical arrays and raw conditioning latents across conditions
development_counterfactual.intervention: Only future-query task text changes; policy and value queries retain original Goal
development_counterfactual.cut_status: Not yet implemented or validated; zero embedding must not be labeled BusCut
development_counterfactual.true_utility: Fixed candidate followed by the same original-Goal N1 policy until first environment task success or absolute step 300; report full task success and steps, separately from 16-step success
development_counterfactual.true_target: Exact t+16 independent environment observation using official image codec; no model-derived target
development_counterfactual.repeat_scope: Determinism verification, not independent statistical samples
development_counterfactual.prediction_commitment: Save and hash candidate controls, predictions and rankings before any counterfactual target/utility replay

broader_clean_readiness.scope: Development readiness threshold, not proof of population performance. All failures retained. Requires a separate held-out evaluation before paper claims.

causal_and_security_boundaries: Language-conditioned future prediction can legitimately use Goal as hidden-state information; Goal sensitivity alone is not a violation.
Branch-only mutation is an explicit experimental access assumption. An externally reachable write surface has not been established.
Ranking flips require independently measured utility loss before being called decision harm.
A defense must preserve useful clean behavior and improve actual task outcomes, not merely enforce constant outputs.
Full-episode attack comparisons may have diverging state trajectories after interventions; fixed-candidate counterfactuals are a separate local estimand.
Do not retune these development choices on held-out attack or utility outcomes.
